item.title: Dallas Man Jailed After Fleeing Troopers at Schuylkill County Construction Site
item.description: A Luzerne County man is locked up in Schuylkill County Prison following an incident earlier this week in which he allegedly fled from Pennsylvania State Police while operating construction equipment at a work site in Mahanoy Township.David Brannigan, 44, of Dallas, Pennsylvania, was arraigned by Magisterial District Judge Anthony Kilker on Monday and committed to Schuylkill County Prison on $50,000 straight cash bail. item.title: PennDOT Reduces Speed Limit on I-81 in Schuylkill County Due to Winter Weather
item.description: PennDOT has reduced the speed limits on Interstate 81 in Schuylkill County due to weather conditions.As of 9:15pm, Saturday, winter weather on I-81 has reduced speed limits between Interstate 78 interchange in Lebanon County to the Interstate 80 interchange in Luzerne County. The speed limit has been reduced to 45 miles per hour. item.title: Schuylkill County Conservancy Announces December Sketchers Walk, New Year’s Day Nature Hike
item.description: The Schuylkill County Conservancy and local partners are inviting the public to take part in two upcoming outdoor events designed to connect residents with nature through creativity and exploration. Schuylkill County Sketchers Nature Walk The first event, a Schuylkill County Sketchers Nature Walk, will take place on Saturday, December 20, from 10:00 to 11:00 a.m. at Sweet Arrow Lake Park in Pine Grove.
